Class SwitchBugemonController

java.lang.Object
controllers.Controller<SelectBugemonFromTeamView>
controllers.fight.SwitchBugemonController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SelectBugemonFromTeamListener
public class SwitchBugemonController extends Controller<SelectBugemonFromTeamView> implements SelectBugemonFromTeamListener
Controller for the Bugemon switch sub-view used during a fight.

Reads the player's team, the current on-field Bugemon id, and the switch mode directly from GameStateHolder. Delegates selection and cancellation back to the ControllerManager which forwards them to FightAgainstCPUController.

    • onBugemonClicked

      public void onBugemonClicked(BugemonDTO bugemon)
      Handles the selection of a Bugemon in the switch sub-view.

      Displays an error message if the selected Bugemon is KO or is already on the field. Otherwise, closes the sub-window and notifies the meta-controller.

      Parameters:
      bugemon - the Bugemon selected by the user
